notes: HD-2D Identity Stage (sprint hd2d-identity-stage). One shared warm-Shenzhen scene for all 12 archetypes. Depth-of-field blur is pre-baked into farBg; no runtime filter. Avatar stands on the mid-bg plaza ground in the lower-right quadrant; bottom-left is reserved for the partner-entry UI panel.

farBg.role: Distant Shenzhen skyline plane with pre-baked depth-of-field blur; the only plane allowed to carry cold purple.

midBg.role: Mid street/plaza plane with warm gold/sunset-pink light sources ($color-landed-gold family); provides the ground the avatar stands on.
